## Appaloosa's Tepper Cuts Micron Stake and Rotates Into Unnamed 'Fabulous' AI Stock for Sixth Consecutive Quarter

Six consecutive quarters of Tepper trimming MU into an unidentified AI name is a meaningful smart-money divergence from the memory cycle bull narrative; juxtaposed with Micron reclaiming the $1,000 level (cluster 055be2632db33cad), this creates a notable tension between price momentum and institutional conviction that warrants resolution.

- David Tepper of Appaloosa Management materially reduced his Micron (MU) position, per 13F disclosures.
- He simultaneously increased exposure to an AI stock he described as 'fabulous' — for the sixth consecutive quarter.
- The target AI stock is not named in either headline; identifying it would require a separate data source.
- The persistent rotation away from MU over six quarters raises questions about Tepper's conviction on the HBM and memory cycle thesis.
- Coverage in Globe and Mail and Yahoo Finance both cited the 13F filing as the source.
